senses.gloss:
सिद्ध १

SIDDHA I . A deva gandharva. This gandharva was born to prajāpati kaśyapa by his wife Prādhā. (mahābhārata, Ādi Parva, Chapter 65, Verse 46).

सिद्ध २

SIDDHA II (the siddhas) . A group of devas. The group of devas called Siddhas lived on the Himālayas near the hermitage of kaṇva. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 70, Verse 15). It is mentioned in mahābhārata, Sabhā Parva, Chapter 8, Verse 29, that this group of Gods stay in the palace of yama serving him.

सिद्धा

SIDDHĀ . The devī (goddess) consecrated in Rambhāvana, wearing a water-vessel with a snout, rosary, boon, and fire, is called siddhā. (See under devī).

सिद्धग्रह

SIDDHAGRAHA . An evil spirit. Those who are cursed by the group of devas called Siddhas are afflicted by this spirit and they become maniacs. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 230, Verse 49).

सिद्धपात्र

SIDDHAPĀTRA . A warrior of subrahmaṇya. (mahābhārata śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Verse 66).

सिद्धार्थ १

SIDDHĀRTHA I . A King. This King was the rebirth of the asura krodhavaśa. (bhārata, Ādi Parva, Chapter 67, Verse 60).

सिद्धार्थ २

SIDDHĀRTHA II . A warrior of subrahmaṇya. (M.B. śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Verse 64).

सिद्धार्थ ३

SIDDHĀRTHA III . The name of buddha in his childhood. (See under buddha).

सिद्धार्थ ४

SIDDHĀRTHA IV . A minister of King daśaratha. (vālmīki rāmāyaṇa, ayodhyā Kāṇḍa, sarga 36).

सिद्धाश्रम

SIDDHĀŚRAMA . A hermitage. The place at which vāmana thrust mahābali down to pātāla. This place became a hermitage later. When viśvāmitra took Śrī rāma and lakṣmaṇa to the forest for the protection of his sacrifice, he showed them this hermitage. (vālmīki rāmāyaṇa, Bālākāṇḍa, sarga 29, Verse 22).

सिद्धि १

SIDDHI I . A daughter of dakṣa. Thirteen daughters including siddhi were married by Dharmadeva. (viṣṇu purāṇa, aṁśa 1, Chapter 7).

सिद्धि २

SIDDHI II . A goddess. kuntī the mother of the pāṇḍavas was the human rebirth of this goddess. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 67, Verse 120). This goddess siddhi had walked in front of the army of subrahmaṇya, in the great battle between the devas and the asuras. To attain the object in any matter, the blessing of this goddess is essential. (M.B. śalya Parva, Chapter 46, Verse 64).

सिद्धि ३

SIDDHI III . The son of an agni (fire) named vīra. siddhi was born to this Vīrāgni, by his wife sarayū. The story stating how this agni once screened the sun by his radiance, occurs in mahābhārata, śalya Parva, Chapter 218.
